articles.title: America by the numbers: How voters feel about the economy, inflation, AI and Trump
articles.description: With the U.S. midterm elections looming, Americans are nearly as gloomy about the economy as they were when the nation was emerging from the pandemic.

articles.title: Netanyahu Is Up for Re-election After Years of War. How Will Voters See Him?

articles.description: President Donald Trump's trade showdown with Canada targets dairy, lumber and market access, reviving decades-old tensions between allied economies.

articles.title: Trump officials warn decades-long decline among American men could carry national security consequences
articles.description: President Donald Trump's administration develops testosterone screening for troops as an HHS official warns 77% of young Americans can't serve.

articles.description: Hope, dread and the final stretch to Election Day.

articles.title: She Planned to Protest Trump. She Didn’t Plan on Getting Punched.

articles.title: Why Democrats Could Find It Hard to Win the Senate Despite Their Strong Polls
articles.description: Democrats are increasingly optimistic about the midterms. But they are being outspent by Republicans. And they are trying to compete in states that favored President Trump by large margins.

articles.title: Drones on Starshield Network Are Back to Normal Speeds, Ukraine Says
articles.description: The announcement followed more than a week of unexplained problems with Starshield, the Pentagon-funded satellite network Ukraine relies on to thwart Russian attacks.

articles.title: Iran in ‘Advanced Stages’ of Planning Attacks Against Americans, Officials Say
articles.description: The U.S. government has ordered diplomats and other federal employees to leave Saudi Arabia. It is also drawing down staff at other missions in the region.

articles.title: Why Is the U.S. Accusing Canada of Election Interference?
articles.description: The Trump administration says Canadian officials are trying to sway the midterm elections for Democrats. Prime Minister Mark Carney says those claims have “no merit.”

articles.title: Israel Cracks Down in West Bank City After Deadly Attack

articles.title: Death toll rises to 9 in church attack as officials blame 'extremist' Islamist ideology

articles.title: El-Sayed Needs Black Voters in Michigan. Tensions With Arab Americans Make That Harder.
articles.description: Conflict between Michigan’s Black and Arab communities could get in the way of Dr. Abdul El-Sayed’s pitch in the critical Senate race.

articles.title: U.S. Pressures Mexico to Deliver a Security Win Ahead of Midterm Elections
articles.description: The Trump administration wants a public victory soon, as well as a potential path to U.S. military forces in Mexico.

articles.title: Trump Asked Muslim Voters to Trust Him. Now Some Feel Used.

articles.title: A 2028 Presidential Poll Finds Vance, Rubio and Several Democrats in the Mix

articles.title: Could Lula Be on the Brink of Defeat in Brazil’s Election?

articles.title: Fact vs. fiction: Doctors share whether peptides are safe and effective

articles.title: Ukraine says Starlink and Starshield high speed restrictions have been lifted

articles.title: Berkshire shares shake the Buffett blues with new all-time highs

articles.title: Justice Dept. Demands That California Counties Help Identify Noncitizen Voters

articles.title: Palestinian Gunmen Open Fire on Israelis in the West Bank, Officials Say
